legalRule: All final textures, models, audio, names, and silhouettes must be original ECHO/Openlands work.

mustNotBorrowFrom: third-party copyrighted packs without explicit license
placeholderPolicy.notes: This manifest is a coverage contract. It proves every MVP id has an Echo-owned placeholder plan; it does not approve placeholder art for public release.

block.cube_all: Use one generated Echo-owned texture on all faces.
block.cube_grass: Use generated Echo-owned side/top/bottom color bands; no vanilla grass layout copy.
block.orientable: Use Openlands log/post banding with original ring and bark shapes.
block.utility: Use simplified Echo silhouettes until final art pass.

item.generated: Use original flat icon silhouette and palette from Openlands material family.
item.tool: Use original tool proportions; avoid recognizable vanilla pick/axe silhouettes.
item.handheld: Use original handheld pose and proportions.

adapterNotes.echo_native: Use Echo asset IDs directly from this namespace.
adapterNotes.echo_runtime_standalone: Bake or stream assets through the standalone runtime asset graph.
adapterNotes.neoforge: Generate pack-compatible resource locations without exposing copied Minecraft content.

foundationAssetDependencies.echomaterialcore: Generic materials, blocks, and metal progression assets.
foundationAssetDependencies.echoworldstarter: Starter shelter, light, campfire, and bedroll assets.
